gff.tolman: DERIVED: active gravitational mass = int (eps + 3p) d^3r (Tolman). von Laue: int p d^3r = 0 for any stable system -> pressure adds exactly zero net gravitating mass; locally the repulsive core (p>0) gravitates MORE (eps+3p > eps), the confining shell (p<0) gravitates less. So positive pressure does NOT make gravity repel; it is the negative (binding) pressure that reduces active mass, and only locally.

brane_fm.nucleon_EMT: KK gravitons couple to the same T_mu_nu whose matrix elements are the GFFs; the correction to graviton-proton amplitudes is ~ (G_eff/G - 1) * G m^2 ~ 1e-25 of the strong force at 1 fm even for n=4 -- no effect on GFF extractions (DVCS measures them via quark GPDs, not via gravity).

equivalence.interpretation: ASSUMED: gravity (or a brane mode) couples to energy component X with strength (1+eps_X). eta = sum eps_X * Delta f_X.
